tool.name: miRge3.0
tool.command:
#set $sample_list = [] #for $i, $sample in enumerate($samples): #set $link = 'input_' + str($i) + '.fastq' ln -s '${sample}' '${link}' && #silent $sample_list.append($link) #end for
miRge3.0 -s '#echo ",".join($sample_list)#' -lib '${library.fields.path}' -on '$organism_name' -db '$mir_db' -cpu \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-4} -o . -onam output_dir
#if $adapter_trimming.adapter: -a '$adapter_trimming.adapter' #end if #if $adapter_trimming.front_adapter: -g '$adapter_trimming.front_adapter' #end if -q $adapter_trimming.quality_cutoff -m $adapter_trimming.minimum_length $adapter_trimming.phred64 $adapter_trimming.trim_n #if str($adapter_trimming.nextseq_trim): -nxt $adapter_trimming.nextseq_trim #end if -ex $advanced.cr_threshold -cms $advanced.chunkmbs
## Analysis flags $atoi $trna_frag $isoform_entropy $gff_out $bam_out $spikein
## UMI #if $umi.umi_selector == "yes": -umi '$umi.uniq_mol_ids' $umi.umi_dedup $umi.qiagen_umi #end if
## miREC error correction #if $mirec.mirec_selector == "yes": -mEC -kh $mirec.threshold -ks $mirec.kmer_start -ke $mirec.kmer_end #end if
## Novel miRNA prediction #if $novel.novel_selector == "yes": -nmir -minl $novel.min_length -maxl $novel.max_length -c $novel.min_read_counts -mloc $novel.max_mapping_loci -sl $novel.seed_length -olc $novel.overlap_len_cutoff -clc $novel.cluster_length #end if
## Differential expression #if $diffex.diffex_selector == "yes": -dex -mdt '$diffex.metadata' #end if
-shh
#if $novel.novel_selector == "yes": && shopt -s nullglob && for f in output_dir/*_novel_miRNAs_miRge2.0.csv; do cat "\$f" >> 'novel_mirnas_combined.csv'; done #end if

param.name: samples
param.label: Input FASTQ files
param.help: One or more small RNA-seq FASTQ files

param.name: library
param.label: Reference Library
param.help: Pre-installed miRge3 reference library for your organism

param.name: adapter
param.label: 3' Adapter Sequence
param.help: Adapter sequence or 'illumina' for standard Illumina small RNA adapter (TGGAATTCTCGGGTGCCAAGG)

param.name: front_adapter
param.label: 5' Adapter Sequence
param.help: Optional 5' adapter sequence to trim

param.name: quality_cutoff
param.label: Quality Cutoff
param.help: Trim low-quality bases from 3' end (default: 10)

param.name: minimum_length
param.label: Minimum Read Length
param.help: Discard reads shorter than this length after trimming (default: 16)

param.name: phred64
param.label: Phred+64 Encoding
param.help: Use Phred+64 quality encoding instead of Phred+33

param.name: trim_n
param.label: Trim Ns from Ends
param.help: Remove N bases from read ends

param.name: nextseq_trim
param.label: NextSeq Quality Trimming
param.help: NextSeq-specific quality trim cutoff

param.name: cr_threshold
param.label: Canonical Read Threshold
param.help: Minimum fraction of reads matching canonical miRNA sequence (default: 0.1)

param.name: chunkmbs
param.label: Bowtie Chunk Memory (MB)
param.help: Memory allocated per bowtie thread (default: 256)

param.name: atoi
param.label: Enable A-to-I Editing Detection
param.help: Detect A-to-I RNA editing events in miRNA sequences

param.name: trna_frag
param.label: Enable tRNA Fragment Analysis
param.help: Analyze tRNA-derived fragments (human only)

param.name: isoform_entropy
param.label: Enable IsomiR Entropy Calculation
param.help: Calculate isomiR entropy for each miRNA

param.name: gff_out
param.label: Output IsomiR GFF File
param.help: Generate a GFF file with isomiR annotations

param.name: bam_out
param.label: Output BAM Files
param.help: Generate BAM alignment files

param.name: spikein
param.label: Enable Spike-in Annotation
param.help: Annotate spike-in sequences

param.name: uniq_mol_ids
param.label: UMI Pattern
param.help: UMI base positions (e.g. '4,4' for 4bp on each end, '0,12' for 12bp at 3' end)

param.name: umi_dedup
param.label: PCR Duplicate Removal
param.help: Remove PCR duplicates using UMI sequences

param.name: qiagen_umi
param.label: Qiagen UMI Mode
param.help: Use Qiagen-specific UMI processing

param.name: threshold
param.label: Frequency Threshold
param.help: Minimum read frequency for error correction (default: 5)

param.name: kmer_start
param.label: K-mer Start
param.help: Starting k-mer size (default: 15)

param.name: kmer_end
param.label: K-mer End
param.help: Ending k-mer size (default: 20)

param.name: min_length
param.label: Minimum Read Length
param.help: Minimum read length for novel miRNA prediction (default: 16)

param.name: max_length
param.label: Maximum Read Length
param.help: Maximum read length for novel miRNA prediction (default: 25)

param.name: min_read_counts
param.label: Minimum Read Counts
param.help: Minimum read count for novel miRNA candidates (default: 2)

param.name: max_mapping_loci
param.label: Maximum Mapping Loci
param.help: Maximum genomic loci a read can map to (default: 3)

param.name: seed_length
param.label: Bowtie Seed Length
param.help: Seed length for bowtie alignment (default: 25)

param.name: overlap_len_cutoff
param.label: Overlap Length Cutoff
param.help: Minimum overlap for read clustering (default: 14)

param.name: cluster_length
param.label: Cluster Maximum Length
param.help: Maximum cluster length (default: 30)

param.name: metadata
param.label: Metadata File
param.help: CSV file with sample metadata for DESeq2 (required for differential expression)

tool.help:
# miRge3.0 - Comprehensive Small RNA-seq Analysis
## What it does
miRge3.0 is a comprehensive pipeline for small RNA-seq data analysis. It performs:
- **Adapter trimming and quality filtering** (via cutadapt) - **Read collapsing** and alignment against miRNA reference libraries (via bowtie) - **Known miRNA quantification** and isomiR analysis - **A-to-I RNA editing detection** - **tRNA fragment (tRF) analysis** (human only) - **Novel miRNA prediction** using a machine learning model - **UMI processing** and PCR duplicate removal - **Differential expression analysis** (via DESeq2) - **Interactive HTML visualization report**
## Input
One or more FASTQ files from small RNA-seq experiments. Both uncompressed (`.fastq`) and gzip-compressed (`.fastq.gz`) files are accepted.
## Reference Libraries
miRge3.0 requires organism-specific reference libraries. These must be pre-installed by a Galaxy administrator. Libraries are available for: human, mouse, rat, zebrafish, nematode, fruitfly, and hamster.
Each library contains bowtie indexes of miRNA hairpin sequences, mature miRNA annotations, and genomic coordinates for isomiR analysis.
## Output
The primary output is an interactive HTML report with visualization of read distributions, miRNA expression, isomiR variants, and more.
Tabular outputs include:
- **miRNA Counts** (`miR.Counts.csv`) - raw read counts per miRNA - **miRNA RPM** (`miR.RPM.csv`) - reads per million normalized counts - **Annotation Report** (`annotation_report.csv`) - detailed alignment statistics - **Mapped Reads** - reads that aligned to miRNA references - **Unmapped Reads** - reads that did not align
Optional outputs (when enabled):
- **IsomiR GFF** - genomic coordinates of isomiR variants - **A-to-I Editing Report** - detected RNA editing events - **tRF Report** - tRNA fragment analysis results - **Novel miRNA Predictions** - predicted novel miRNAs - **Differential Expression** - DESeq2 results with volcano and PCA plots
## Adapter Trimming
By default, miRge3.0 uses the standard Illumina small RNA 3' adapter (`TGGAATTCTCGGGTGCCAAGG`). You can specify a custom adapter sequence or use the `illumina` shorthand for the standard adapter.
## Notes
- **tRF analysis** is only available for human samples - **Differential expression** requires a metadata CSV file with sample group assignments - **Novel miRNA prediction** requires a genome reference library with genomic coordinates - The HTML report uses interactive JavaScript visualizations (HighCharts, DataTables)
For more details, see the miRge3.0 documentation: https://mirge3.readthedocs.io/
